title: GM Announces transfer of stock exchange listing to Nasdaq
content: DETROIT, Oct. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- General Motors (NYSE: GM) today announced that it will transfer the listing of its common stock, par value $0.01 per share (the "Common Stock"), to the Nasdaq Global Select Market ("Nasdaq") from the New York Stock Exchange ("NYSE").
